create_csv_dataset: create a CSVDataset from a semicolon-delimited CSV file with sender_input and label columns
get_n_features: get the number of input features from the first sample in the CSVDataset
get_output_size: get the output label size from the first sample in the CSVDataset
get_output_max: get the maximum label value across all samples in the CSVDataset
getitem_dataset: retrieve a specific (sender_input, label) tensor pair by index from the CSVDataset
